_note: The bought guns (Sci-Fi Battle Weapons by Tirgames; Phase 21, docs/PHASE_21_OVERNIGHT_PLAN.md): which model each SpeedKills gun wears when the paid files are here (npm run paid makes them, locally), and its procedural model otherwise. The legacy game never wears them. model is a file under models; a _2 build is split into its moving parts (Clip, Slide, Pump), so its magazine comes out on a reload. skins is the order the gun's three skins come in as its fusion level rises (as found, levels 2 to 3, levels 4 to 5): a gun sharing a family with another starts from a different one, so the pair differs at a glance. model is the gun's own; a player may pick any model of its family instead, and which skin its levels start from (src/game/gunpick.ts, the Loadouts tab). Every model's measurements (its length, muzzle and sight top) are in src/config/paidmodels.json, which tools/checks/paid-weapons.ts writes off the models and fails when they part.
_glow: How bright a bought gun's glow (its emission map) is at each fusion level, 0 to 5: a step a level, so a fused gun reads as better at a glance. Ours.
_props: The rest of the pack where the game has the thing (W7): the model a prop wears when the paid files are here, and its skin. mine is the MINE hack's mine (ours was a lit ring); its size is the model's own. deathbox is a death box (ours was a dark crate with an orange glow). carepackage is a care package (ours was a lit cylinder), the 1.51 m weapon case drawn at scale, which reads from further off. healkit is the med kit standing in the middle of a HEAL area (ours was the lit ring alone), 0.40 by 0.38 m on its own base; healkitEnemy the same in another skin, for an enemy's area.
